requirements.title: DC and DP temporarily set decimal edit mode to COMMA and POINT
requirements.definition: DC and DP temporarily change decimal edit mode to COMMA and POINT respectively.
requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans use independent literal expected strings or scalar sentinels. Negative plans change one property from a conforming control and attribute the violation to this unit only.

S13.8.9-001 control edit descriptor runtime fixtures: dc_outputs_comma_decimal uses write(buf,'(DC,F3.1)') 1.5 and expects '1,5': 1.5 is exact; DC selects COMMA decimal mode, so F3.1 writes comma as the decimal symbol. dp_outputs_point_decimal uses write(buf,'(DP,F3.1)') 1.5 and expects '1.5': 1.5 is exact; DP selects POINT decimal mode, so F3.1 writes point as the decimal symbol.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Pending output plans use internal WRITE to a CHARACTER variable and name exact expected characters including blanks when the unit is internally testable. Unnumbered prose restrictions are not promoted to numbered-constraint diagnostics. Where the source makes a behavior processor dependent, or where a rule requires external stream/direct/sequential files or unregistered defined I/O, the pending plan is explicitly source-control or unassertable rather than a fixture oracle.

S13.8.9-001 control edit descriptor fixture boundaries: Only the listed executable facets are represented. Every character-output case pre-fills the internal file variable or array with '#', asserts LEN where a character scalar is observed, and compares the whole field or assembled record with an equal-length literal so blank padding cannot hide a short oracle. The fixtures do not assert processor-defined sign or leading-zero modes, nondefault-character skipped positions, external sequential/stream/direct file positioning, diagnostics, or G0 processor-selected parameters. Mutation plans are generated with each parent source: wrong oracle, changed input value, control-descriptor removal where portable, and descriptor substitutions for T3/T4, TL2/TR2, SP/SS, DC/DP, and BN/BZ.

requirements.title: Decimal edit mode controls decimal symbols only for real and complex D/E/EN/ES/EX/F/G editing
requirements.definition: Decimal edit mode controls the decimal symbol during real and complex conversion and affects only D, E, EN, ES, EX, F, and G editing.
